description.zh:
统计实例告警的数据来源，默认值为aqs：
- *sas*：态势感知数据源
- *aqs*：告警事件数据
- *honeypot*：蜜罐
description.en:
The data source for statistics on instance alarms, with a default value of aqs:
- *sas*: Situation Awareness data source
- *aqs*: Alarm event data
- *honeypot*: Honeypot
